verses.text: I have a lot of enemies, LORD. Many fight against
me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, LORD, protect me.
Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
Come and save me, LORD God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
because you protect and bless your people.
